title: Patch: a player's repeated hellos on a match socket are answered at most once a second, as a watcher's are
thread:
**Issue #2686 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2686: Patch: a player's repeated hellos on a match socket are answered at most once a second, as a watcher's are
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a player's browser reconnects to a match, it says hello and the server answers with the whole board. A script can say hello over and over and read every answer, and the server rebuilds and sends the full board, the clock, the portraits and the cosmetics each time, under the same lock the opponent's moves wait on. A watcher's socket was recently given a one-answer-per-second limit for exactly this (#2609). Once built, a player's own socket gets the same limit, so a scripted flood costs one board a second, while a real reconnect, which always starts with a fresh hello, is answered at once.

## Why
- R2609000 (issue #2609): a watcher's later hello is answered at most once per `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, because “a script that reads as fast as it sends had the actor send a view for every hello under the lock both players' moves wait on” (`crates/server/src/config.rs:605-608`; `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs:2833-2836`; `SeatGuard::hello_answer_allowed`, `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs:99-108`).
- A seat's hellos only coalesce while one is queued (R835001, `match_actor.rs:1995-2004`), and the flag is cleared as the task starts (`:727-733`), so a client that sends again as soon as each answer arrives keeps one hello queued for ever. Each run clears `card_picks_sent` and resends the loadouts, the view with `engine::legal_actions`, the clock, the portraits and every card's picks (`:736-745`, `push_view` at `:886-895`), about five frames for a 30-byte hello. `WS_OUTBOX_MAX_FRAMES` bounds only a reader that falls behind (R1441).
- Co-op does the same: `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs:1047-1053` and its hello task (`:597-607`, `push_seat` at `:721-725`).
- A real page probes only after its socket has been quiet past `WS_PING_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (`apps/web/src/game/net.ts:611`, `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts:480`), so it never sends two hellos inside a second.

## Proposal
- In both hello arms, before queueing: drop a hello from the same socket generation that comes sooner than `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` after that seat's last answered one, through the seat's `SeatGuard` (renaming the guard's doc from “a watcher's” to “a socket's”). The first hello of a new socket generation (a reattach) is always answered and starts the interval.
- Reuse `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, or rename it to cover both, in `crates/server/src/config.rs` (exported to `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts` by `tests/export_config.rs` if the client reads it).
- A ruling in this issue's block amending R835001, with `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; rejected alternative to record: closing the socket on a hello flood, which would end an honest page's game on a reconnect storm.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`, `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs`, `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`, `crates/server/src/config.rs`
- Tests: `crates/server/tests/actor/ws_server.rs`, `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §9.5, §9.8

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On `/ws/match`, ten hellos from one socket inside a second, each sent after the previous answer arrived, are answered once; one more a second later is answered.
- [ ] A reattach on a new socket is answered at once, however recent the old socket's last answer.
- [ ] The same holds on `/ws/duos`.
- [ ] A player's actions are never delayed or refused by the hello limit.
- [ ] Tests are named after the new ruling and listed in its `proven_in`; `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, clippy and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks
Small: about 20 lines across two actors, a reused constant, tests and a ruling. Risk: a client that lost a view and asks again within a second waits up to a second for it; the page only asks after a quiet socket, so none does.

---

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41322304924)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Limit later `hello` replies on both `/ws/match` and `/ws/duos` to one per `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` for the same socket generation, while preserving queued-hello coalescing, normal action handling, and an immediate reply for the first hello after reattach. Record the rule as R2686000, including the rejected socket-closing alternative, and prove the sequential-flood, interval-reset, action, and reattach cases on both endpoints.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs` | change | Generalize `SeatGuard::hello_answer_allowed` from a watcher-only timestamp to a generation-aware socket gate. |
| `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs` | change | Gate a player's later `ClientMessage::Hello` before enqueueing and pass a watcher socket id to the generalized guard. |
| `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs` | change | Apply the same generation-aware gate to `DuosClientMessage::Hello`. |
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | Broaden the existing `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` documentation to cover player and watcher sockets; keep its name and value. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/ws_server.rs` | change | Add R2686000 coverage over the real `/ws/match` listener. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs` | change | Add paused-clock R2686000 coverage over `/ws/duos`. |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | Update the match and co-op socket contracts with the per-generation hello interval. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | Amend §9.5 reconnect and §9.8 action-flooding text. |
| `spec/13-duos.md` | change | Amend §13.9's co-op hello rule. |
| `spec/rulings/R835001.md` | change | Link the amendment that limits later hellos after queued coalescing. |
| `spec/rulings/R2686000.md` | new | Define the per-socket-generation player hello limit and rejected alternative. |
| `spec/pending/2686.md` | new | Add issue #2686's pending §11 paragraph. |

Do not touch `apps/web/**` (especially generated `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts`), `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, manifests or lockfiles, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, and `.claude/`. The governing text is SPEC §9.5, §9.8 and §13.9, with R835001, R1441 and R2609000; no client change or config export is needed because the client does not read this interval.

## Steps

1. In `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs`, change `SeatGuard::hello_answered` to `Option<(u64, i64)>`, where the tuple is socket generation and answer time. Change `hello_answer_allowed` to `pub fn hello_answer_allowed(&mut self, generation: u64, now: i64) -> bool`: reject only when the stored generation matches and its time is less than `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` old; otherwise store `(generation, now)` and allow. Rewrite its field, struct, and method docs from “a watcher's” to “a socket's,” cite R2686000 for player generations, and retain R2609000 for watchers; do not reset or replace the rest of `SeatGuard` on attach.
2. In `MatchActor::on_frame` in `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`, keep `hello_pending` as the first short-circuit: only when it is not already `Some(generation)` call `core.guards[home].hello_answer_allowed(generation, now_ms())`; enqueue `Task::Hello` and set `hello_pending` only when allowed. A dropped hello sends no error and does not touch action handling. In `answer_watcher_hello`, pass watcher `id` as the stable generation to the same method so R2609000 behavior stays unchanged. Update the nearby `Core::guards`, hello arm, and watcher comments with R2686000.
3. In `DuosActor::on_frame` in `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`, mirror the match actor exactly: first coalesce an already-pending hello for the current `socket_generation[index]`, then consult `core.guards[index].hello_answer_allowed(generation, now_ms())`, and enqueue only an allowed hello. Update the module, `Core::guards`, and hello-arm comments; leave ping and action arms independent.
4. In `crates/server/src/config.rs`, keep `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS: i64 = 1_000` and its public name, but document that R2609000 applies it to watcher sockets and R2686000 reuses it for a player's later hellos in one socket generation, with a new generation always allowed. Reuse it instead of renaming it: the task explicitly permits reuse, the value and watcher contract do not change, and the client does not read it, so renaming would only churn existing ruling and test vocabulary. Do not export it to the web.
5. In `crates/server/tests/actor/ws_server.rs`, import `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` and add named test constants `HELLO_BURST: usize = 10` and `HELLO_SETTLE: Duration = Duration::from_millis(50)`. Add `Client::next_of_type` and `Client::messages_until_silent` helpers so the test can consume complete multi-frame hello replies without mistaking loadouts, clocks, portraits, or card picks for views. Add module `r2686000_player_hello_limit` with test `r2686000_match_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once`: drain the attach frames; send one hello and wait for its view; send the other nine one at a time with enough settling that pre-change queued coalescing cannot hide their replies, all before the interval ends; assert the burst produced one view and the socket stayed open; send an empty-keep mulligan and receive its non-rate-limited ack; after the interval send another hello and receive one view; then replace the socket, drain its full attach reply, immediately send its first later hello, and receive another view despite the old generation's recent answer. Hold `SERIAL` for the whole test.
6. In `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`, import `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, add module `r2686000_player_hello_limit`, and add `r2686000_duos_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once` with `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`. Use `Duos::seat`, `registry(...).get`, `settle`, and `actor.idle()` after each of ten individually sent hellos so each would have completed before the next without the new limit; assert one new view and no close. Submit the view's legal mulligan through `act` and assert an ack, advance exactly the configured interval and assert one more hello view, then reconnect the same account and assert its first later hello gets a view immediately.
7. Update `crates/server/README.md`: in “What the actor holds,” add the per-generation answered-hello timestamp to `SeatGuard`; in “The co-op socket,” state that queued repeats coalesce and later same-generation hellos are answered once per `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, while a reattach starts a generation that is allowed immediately. Cite R2686000 and leave the watcher paragraph's R2609000 contract intact.
8. Add `spec/rulings/R2686000.md` with `id: R2686000`, a title naming player hello replies per socket generation, `cards: "§9.5, §9.8, §13.9, R835001, R1441, R2609000"`, and both test files in `proven_in`. State that R835001 alone bounded only queued work; same-generation later hellos are now dropped unanswered until `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, the first hello of every new generation is allowed immediately, and action processing is unaffected. Record rejection of closing a flooding socket because reconnect storms from an honest page must not end its game.
9. Amend `spec/rulings/R835001.md` with an “Amended by [[R2686000]]” paragraph rather than rewriting its original coalescing guarantee. In `spec/09-architecture.md`, add the same-generation interval and immediate reattach to §9.5's reconnect bullet and make §9.8's Action flooding row cover player, co-op, and watcher hello replies. In `spec/13-duos.md` §13.9, extend the hello/coalescing bullet with the new interval and generation rule.
10. Add `spec/pending/2686.md` with the dated §11 paragraph for issue #2686: name R2686000 as the first number in the issue block, summarize the old queue-only gap and both endpoints' new guard, name the no-effect-on-actions and reattach guarantees, record the rejected close-on-flood alternative, and say it amends R835001 and edits §9.5, §9.8 and §13.9. Do not edit `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`, and do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/actor/ws_server.rs`: `r2686000_match_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once` proves the sequential ten-hello burst, one-second recovery, independent action ack, and immediate new generation on `/ws/match`.
- `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`: `r2686000_duos_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once` proves the same contract on `/ws/duos` with paused time.
- Run:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::ws_server::r2686000_player_hello_limit`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::duos::r2686000_player_hello_limit`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::match_actor::m6_t4_the_match_actor::r835001_coalesces_queued_hellos_but_never_across_a_reattach`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::duos::hello_coalescing::hellos_repeated_while_one_is_queued_coalesce_and_a_newer_socket_always_gets_its_own`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::watch::r2609000_a_watcher_keeps_a_seats_limits`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo jackioh catalog check`
  - `cargo jackioh patches check`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`

## Done when

- [ ] Same-generation match and co-op hello floods produce at most one full reply per configured interval, including when each prior task was allowed to finish.
- [ ] One more hello at the interval boundary is answered, and a new socket generation is answered immediately.
- [ ] Legal actions are acknowledged normally while the hello gate is closed; no socket is closed for repeated hellos.
- [ ] R835001 coalescing and R2609000 watcher behavior still pass.
- [ ] R2686000, its two named proving tests, the pending §11 paragraph, and all three affected spec sections agree.
- [ ] Targeted server tests, server clippy, rustfmt, catalog check, patches check, and spec check pass with no generated web diff.

## Risks

- Keying only by seat would delay an honest reattach; storing generation with the timestamp avoids that without resetting action, rejection, or malformed-frame history.
- Recording the interval before checking `hello_pending` would let a coalesced, unanswered frame move the window; preserve the stated short-circuit order.
- A 1v1 hello emits several frames, so its test must count `view` frames after draining the whole reply. Keep the burst comfortably below one real-time interval to avoid timing flakes.
- This is actor-local transport state only: do not put it in game state, logs, replays, persistence, or client code, so determinism and hidden-information boundaries are unchanged.

## Open questions

None.

Record the rule as R2686000, including the rejected socket-closing alternative, and prove the sequential-flood, interval-reset, action, and reattach cases on both endpoints.

| `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs` | change | Generalize `SeatGuard::hello_answer_allowed` from a watcher-only timestamp to a generation-aware socket gate. |
| `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs` | change | Gate a player's later `ClientMessage::Hello` before enqueueing and pass a watcher socket id to the generalized guard. |
| `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs` | change | Apply the same generation-aware gate to `DuosClientMessage::Hello`. |
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | Broaden the existing `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` documentation to cover player and watcher sockets; keep its name and value. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/ws_server.rs` | change | Add R2686000 coverage over the real `/ws/match` listener. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs` | change | Add paused-clock R2686000 coverage over `/ws/duos`. |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | Update the match and co-op socket contracts with the per-generation hello interval. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | Amend §9.5 reconnect and §9.8 action-flooding text. |
| `spec/13-duos.md` | change | Amend §13.9's co-op hello rule. |
| `spec/rulings/R835001.md` | change | Link the amendment that limits later hellos after queued coalescing. |
| `spec/rulings/R2686000.md` | new | Define the per-socket-generation player hello limit and rejected alternative. |
| `spec/pending/2686.md` | new | Add issue #2686's pending §11 paragraph. |

Do not touch `apps/web/**` (especially generated `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts`), `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, manifests or lockfiles, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, and `.claude/`. The governing text is SPEC §9.5, §9.8 and §13.9, with R835001, R1441 and R2609000; no client change or config export is needed because the client does not read this interval.

## Steps

1. In `crates/server/src/actor/guard.rs`, change `SeatGuard::hello_answered` to `Option<(u64, i64)>`, where the tuple is socket generation and answer time. Change `hello_answer_allowed` to `pub fn hello_answer_allowed(&mut self, generation: u64, now: i64) -> bool`: reject only when the stored generation matches and its time is less than `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS` old; otherwise store `(generation, now)` and allow. Rewrite its field, struct, and method docs from “a watcher's” to “a socket's,” cite R2686000 for player generations, and retain R2609000 for watchers; do not reset or replace the rest of `SeatGuard` on attach.
2. In `MatchActor::on_frame` in `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`, keep `hello_pending` as the first short-circuit: only when it is not already `Some(generation)` call `core.guards[home].hello_answer_allowed(generation, now_ms())`; enqueue `Task::Hello` and set `hello_pending` only when allowed. A dropped hello sends no error and does not touch action handling. In `answer_watcher_hello`, pass watcher `id` as the stable generation to the same method so R2609000 behavior stays unchanged. Update the nearby `Core::guards`, hello arm, and watcher comments with R2686000.
3. In `DuosActor::on_frame` in `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`, mirror the match actor exactly: first coalesce an already-pending hello for the current `socket_generation[index]`, then consult `core.guards[index].hello_answer_allowed(generation, now_ms())`, and enqueue only an allowed hello. Update the module, `Core::guards`, and hello-arm comments; leave ping and action arms independent.
4. In `crates/server/src/config.rs`, keep `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS: i64 = 1_000` and its public name, but document that R2609000 applies it to watcher sockets and R2686000 reuses it for a player's later hellos in one socket generation, with a new generation always allowed. Reuse it instead of renaming it: the task explicitly permits reuse, the value and watcher contract do not change, and the client does not read it, so renaming would only churn existing ruling and test vocabulary. Do not export it to the web.

Hold `SERIAL` for the whole test.
6. In `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`, import `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, add module `r2686000_player_hello_limit`, and add `r2686000_duos_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once` with `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`. Use `Duos::seat`, `registry(...).get`, `settle`, and `actor.idle()` after each of ten individually sent hellos so each would have completed before the next without the new limit; assert one new view and no close. Submit the view's legal mulligan through `act` and assert an ack, advance exactly the configured interval and assert one more hello view, then reconnect the same account and assert its first later hello gets a view immediately.

Update `crates/server/README.md`: in “What the actor holds,” add the per-generation answered-hello timestamp to `SeatGuard`; in “The co-op socket,” state that queued repeats coalesce and later same-generation hellos are answered once per `WATCH_HELLO_INTERVAL_MS`, while a reattach starts a generation that is allowed immediately. Cite R2686000 and leave the watcher paragraph's R2609000 contract intact.
8. Add `spec/rulings/R2686000.md` with `id: R2686000`, a title naming player hello replies per socket generation, `cards: "§9.5, §9.8, §13.9, R835001, R1441, R2609000"`, and both test files in `proven_in`. Record rejection of closing a flooding socket because reconnect storms from an honest page must not end its game.
9. Amend `spec/rulings/R835001.md` with an “Amended by [[R2686000]]” paragraph rather than rewriting its original coalescing guarantee. In `spec/09-architecture.md`, add the same-generation interval and immediate reattach to §9.5's reconnect bullet and make §9.8's Action flooding row cover player, co-op, and watcher hello replies. In `spec/13-duos.md` §13.9, extend the hello/coalescing bullet with the new interval and generation rule.
10. Add `spec/pending/2686.md` with the dated §11 paragraph for issue #2686: name R2686000 as the first number in the issue block, summarize the old queue-only gap and both endpoints' new guard, name the no-effect-on-actions and reattach guarantees, record the rejected close-on-flood alternative, and say it amends R835001 and edits §9.5, §9.8 and §13.9. - `crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`: `r2686000_duos_hellos_are_answered_once_per_interval_actions_continue_and_a_new_generation_answers_at_once` proves the same contract on `/ws/duos` with paused time.
- Run:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::ws_server::r2686000_player_hello_limit`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::duos::r2686000_player_hello_limit`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::match_actor::m6_t4_the_match_actor::r835001_coalesces_queued_hellos_but_never_across_a_reattach`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::duos::hello_coalescing::hellos_repeated_while_one_is_queued_coalesce_and_a_newer_socket_always_gets_its_own`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::watch::r2609000_a_watcher_keeps_a_seats_limits`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo jackioh catalog check`
  - `cargo jackioh patches check`
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`

## Done when

- [ ] Same-generation match and co-op hello floods produce at most one full reply per configured interval, including when each prior task was allowed to finish.
- [ ] One more hello at the interval boundary is answered, and a new socket generation is answered immediately.
- [ ] Legal actions are acknowledged normally while the hello gate is closed; no socket is closed for repeated hellos.
- [ ] R835001 coalescing and R2609000 watcher behavior still pass.
- [ ] R2686000, its two named proving tests, the pending §11 paragraph, and all three affected spec sections agree.
- [ ] Targeted server tests, server clippy, rustfmt, catalog check, patches check, and spec check pass with no generated web diff.

## Risks

- Keying only by seat would delay an honest reattach; storing generation with the timestamp avoids that without resetting action, rejection, or malformed-frame history.
- Recording the interval before checking `hello_pending` would let a coalesced, unanswered frame move the window; preserve the stated short-circuit order.
- A 1v1 hello emits several frames, so its test must count `view` frames after draining the whole reply. Keep the burst comfortably below one real-time interval to avoid timing flakes.

None.
